# contributing to `cors`

CORS is a node.js package for providing a [connect](http://example.invalid/connect/)/[express](http://example.invalid/) middleware that can be used to enable [CORS](http://example.invalid/wiki/Cross-origin_resource_sharing) with various options. Learn more about the project in [the README](README.md).

## The CORS Spec

[http://example.invalid/TR/cors/](http://example.invalid/TR/cors/)

## Pull Requests Welcome

* Include `'use strict';` in every javascript file.
* 2 space indentation.
* Please run the testing steps below before submitting.

## Testing

```bash
$ npm install
$ npm test
```
